Subject: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 – update on appeal in the 
matter of Asier Metals Private Limited vs. Polycab India Limited. 
In continuation our earlier intimations dated October 07, 2026, October 08, 2026, October 09, 2026,  October 
14, 2026, October 16, 2026 and October 28, 2026, we wish to inform that in the matter of Asier Metals Private 
Limited vs. Polycab India Limited ("Company"), the Hon'ble NCLAT vide its order dated October 30, 2026 has 
allowed the Appeal filed by the Company and set aside the order of the Hon'ble National Company Law 
Tribunal, Ahmedabad Bench dated October 07, 2026. A copy of the order of the Hon'ble NCLAT is attached 
herewith.
